name: Favoritos — marcar e desmarcar um comando

planSteps.description: Click the category header labeled '1. Limpeza Geral' to expand it
Click the empty star (☆) on the 'Limpar Cache DNS' command card
The star changes to a filled star (⭐) and the favorites bar appears with 'Limpar Cache DNS'
Click the filled star (⭐) on the same command card again
The star returns to empty (☆) and the favorites bar is hidden or no longer lists the command
